attribution: Card ids, categories and recipe intent are derived from the video-shotcraft shot-card taxonomy (Apache-2.0). See docs/LICENSING.md.

cards.title: Spotlight Hero
cards.purpose: Open on the product surface with a moving spotlight so the eye lands on the UI before any copy appears.
pitfalls: A spotlight tighter than ~35% of the frame reads as a vignette bug, not a highlight.
Do not stack a headline over the spotlight centre — the two fight for the same pixels.

cards.title: Paper Title Card
cards.purpose: State the promise on a flat paper-stock card: one headline, one sub, nothing else.
pitfalls: More than ~7 words in the headline stops being readable at 9:16.
Keep it on screen for at least 0.7s or it reads as a flash frame.

cards.title: Typewriter Moves
cards.purpose: Type the value proposition in, character by character, so the viewer reads at the narrator's pace.
pitfalls: Typing speed must finish before the shot ends, or the sentence is never seen whole.
A blinking caret on the last frame looks like a stall — settle it.

cards.title: Deck Deal Fly-In
cards.purpose: Deal three feature cards in like playing cards to show breadth without a wall of text.
pitfalls: Stagger the deal; simultaneous arrival reads as a single blurry object.
Three cards is the ceiling at 9:16 — a fourth clips off-frame.

cards.title: Row Embed
cards.purpose: Embed the real captured UI in a device row so the claim is evidenced by the product itself.
pitfalls: A 16:9 capture cropped to 9:16 loses the sidebar — respect the variant safe area.
Never scale a 1x capture up; ingest at device_scale_factor=2.

cards.title: Crash Zoom Punch
cards.purpose: Punch into one detail of the capture on the beat to mark the single most important moment.
pitfalls: One crash zoom per video. Two reads as a glitch.
The punch frame must land exactly on a beat or the whole cut feels late.

cards.title: Odometer Digit Roll
cards.purpose: Roll a headline number up like an odometer so a metric feels earned rather than asserted.
pitfalls: Roll to a real number; a fake metric is the fastest way to lose a technical audience.
Rolling more than 4 digits at 30fps turns into unreadable mush.

cards.title: Beat Cut Moves
cards.purpose: Hard-cut between framings strictly on the beat grid to carry momentum through the middle of the video.
pitfalls: Cuts off the beat grid feel like dropped frames — this card must be beat-snapped.
Four cuts inside one second is a seizure risk; keep sub-shots >= 6 frames.

cards.title: Wipe Transitions
cards.purpose: Wipe from one colour field to the next to change subject without a jarring jump cut.
pitfalls: A wipe slower than ~0.5s reads as a loading screen.
Wipe direction should match the reading direction of the copy it reveals.

cards.title: UI to Brand Morph
cards.purpose: Morph the product surface into the brand lockup so the last frame is the thing you want remembered.
pitfalls: Hold the final lockup for >= 0.5s after the morph settles, or the end card is unreadable.
On the muted loop variant the outro must still work with no audio cue.
